Building: Coit Tower, San Francisco (monument tower).
The front (−z) is the parking circle side.
Footprint: 21.9 m along x by 22.2 m along z, centred on the origin.
Outline (from OpenStreetMap), [x, z] in metres, going round:

Height: the highest point is 64 m above the ground.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. whole fluted concrete tower on its hilltop with trees below, clear sky
  2. tower rising behind the Telegraph Hill apartment building, showing the full shaft and the arcaded crown, flag on top
  3. high oblique aerial of the tower and the circular drive and park on Telegraph Hill

json.notes: Coit Tower: a plain, slightly tapering round concrete shaft on a low base, with an arcaded observation crown of arched openings near the top. The signature feature is the round shaft with the open arched crown, so I model it as a stacked round tower with an arched belfry stage. A low square plinth sits under it.

final.notes: Coit Tower: a plain, slightly tapering round concrete shaft on a low base, with an arcaded observation crown of arched openings near the top. The signature feature is the round shaft with the open arched crown, so I model it as a stacked round tower with an arched belfry stage. A low square plinth sits under it.

photos: photo 1: the whole fluted concrete tower on its hilltop with trees below, showing the smooth cylindrical shaft and the open arched crown under clear sky
photo 2: the tower rising behind the Telegraph Hill apartment block, showing the full shaft, the arcaded crown with its arched openings and a flag on top
photo 3: high oblique aerial of the tower standing in trees beside the circular drive and park, with the tower's round base and plinth visible

components.name: fluted shaft
components.why: photos 1 and 2 show a tall plain round concrete shaft with an arcaded observation crown near the top; photo 3 shows it as a round tower on the hill

components.name: base plinth
components.why: photo 3 shows a low square-ish base platform under the tower
